VI.description: Where the FRAME of the window hWnd is on screen - the part of the front panel window that RemoteVI streams\3A its client area\2C everything below the title bar and inside the borders. For a LabVIEW front panel that is the menu bar\2C the toolbar\2C the panel and its scrollbars\3A LabVIEW draws its menu bar itself inside the client area (measured on LabVIEW 2025\3A GetMenu returns NULL and GetMenuBarInfo fails for a panel with the default and with a custom run-time menu bar)\2C and so are the toolbar and the panel scrollbars. rect.x and rect.y are the screen position of the client-area origin (the negative of user32 ScreenToClient applied to the screen point 0\2C0)\2C rect.w and rect.h its size (user32 GetClientRect). A minimized or vanished window gives w or h 0. Win32 only\2C no VI Server call\2C so it works while a popup's modal loop holds LabVIEW's UI thread.
